submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gap is recommended as it is the only mixture that can meet the hard environmental constraint of GWP100 ≤ 150. Being described as an "alternative mixture based on newer replacement gases," Mixture-G1 is specifically designed to meet modern environmental regulations, unlike Mixture-G2 (standard fluorinated mixture with typical GWP > 1000) and Mixture-G3 (partial substitute, likely still exceeding GWP limit). Among the gas gaps tested for Mixture-G1, the 2.0 mm configuration achieves the best time resolution of 1.998 ns. While Mixture-G2 would offer superior time resolution (0.905 ns at 2.0 mm), it violates the mandatory GWP100 constraint and therefore cannot be used. The 2.0 mm gap represents an optimal balance for Mixture-G1, showing better performance than smaller (2.276 ns at 1 mm) or larger (2.327 ns at 3 mm) gaps.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Among environmentally compliant options, Mixture-G1 at 2.0 mm gap achieves the best time resolution of 1.998 ns. This is the optimal performance available within the GWP100 ≤ 150 constraint.

requirements.requirement: The global-warming potential (GWP100) of the mixture must not exceed 150 (hard requirement)
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G1 is described as an 'alternative mixture based on newer replacement gases,' which are specifically developed to meet stringent environmental regulations with GWP100 < 150. Mixture-G2 (standard fluorinated) and Mixture-G3 (partial substitute) likely exceed this limit.
The recommended gas gap of 2.0 mm is within the required range of 1-3 mm.
